Use the agent on my computer
Scan the code in the Agent app on your computer or server. No keys on this phone.
In the browser: tap Authorize. %1$s then shows a code. Copy it, come back here, and paste it below.
Rings through Do Not Disturb until you answer: permissions and a test
Off. Say your agent\'s name to open it from anywhere
Not listening yet: open the app once
Off · tap to set it up
Other apps, while you keep your screen
Stopped by you. Tap to allow your agent to use it again
On. Setup, rules and blocked apps

Sites that need advanced browser features
What you dictated: the words and the audio
Let MacroDroid, Tasker or any app on this phone fire one of your routines, over the address below or by intent. Anything that needs your approval is refused.
Copy it, then paste it into the macro as a Bearer token
A new token stops every macro that holds the old one. You paste the new one in.
A macro may fire a routine. Anything needing your approval is refused.
Works when the app is closed. Same token, same switch.
Only this phone can reach the address, and only while the app is running. The intent works when it is closed too.

Some sites do heavy work inside the page and need shared memory for it: WhatsApp Web calls, in-browser editors, Ai models that run in the page. Your agent\'s browser allows it only for the sites listed here. Add only sites you trust.
No sites yet. Add one below.
Secure sites only (https), by their exact address. Changes apply to new tabs.
Let the agent speak in WhatsApp calls
On: in a WhatsApp Web call your agent places here, its voice goes into the call and it hears the other person.
Off. Your agent can\'t speak in a WhatsApp Web call.
Turn on calling for a test account
On: when your agent places a call and the number signed in to WhatsApp Web is one listed below, calling is switched on in that page. Never for any other number.
Off. Your agent can only call from accounts WhatsApp has given calling to.
Add the test account\'s number first.
The number of the WhatsApp account you test with. Nothing is sent to WhatsApp, and reloading the page undoes it.
The computer\'s answer didn\'t make sense. Is its Agent app up to date?
That QR code isn\'t an Agent link code.
Link this phone to a computer or server
Your agent runs on %1$s. This phone shows its chat, memory, tasks and routines, and holds no AI keys for it.
Check that %1$s shows this code next to this phone:
Unlinked. Make a new code on your computer and try again.
It uses %1$s now. Linking to %2$s replaces that link. Go ahead only if you made this code on your own computer.
On your computer, open the Agent app and go to Settings, Devices, Add a device.
Type the address and the code it shows.
Point this camera at the code it shows.
Type the address and code instead
That doesn\'t look like an address.
Nothing can answer right now. Your computers are off or out of reach.
The chat, memory, tasks and routines here are your computer\'s. Your phone\'s own stay as they were.
Off: this phone uses its own agent and data.
Tried in this order. Change the order on a computer: Settings, Devices.
On, but can\'t run the agent now
Let your computers use this phone\'s
So the agent there can browse from here, read notifications you allowed, and ask you.
This phone forgets %1$s and the copy of its data. Nothing on the computer changes, and this phone\'s own chat, memory and keys stay as they were.
Other apps: intents, music and video, macros (intents and macros ask unless allowed)
Saved to Downloads. Tap to open.

Typed names work best when they read naturally in English letters. Any other name, or any other language, works once you teach it your voice.

Which app plays your music and video · automatic

When you ask your agent to play something, it uses the app you pick here. Left on automatic, it uses your phone\'s default, then any app that can play from a search. Nothing leaves the phone except the YouTube search for a video.
Android only shows what is playing, and lets your agent pause or skip, once Agent has notification access.
No app on this phone says it can play music or video for your agent. Install a music app and it shows up here.
Tap a chosen app again to go back to automatic.
Intents and macros · anything that changes something asks you first
%1$s can run without asking; others ask

Your agent can send any app on this phone an Android intent: open a place in Maps, share into an app, run a MacroDroid or Tasker macro. Opening a screen never asks. Anything else asks you first, unless it is listed here. Nothing leaves the phone.
An action and the app it goes to, like android.intent.action.SEND | com.whatsapp. Use * for any app. When you approve one, the card shows the line to add.
Sent. Your maps app should open on Sandton City.
Opens Sandton City in your maps app, by intent.
One macro name per line, e.g. Wifi off
These run without asking. Any other macro asks you first, and is not sent when nobody answers.
Sent \"%1$s\". Nothing happened? In the trigger, the extra\'s name must be macro in small letters, with no space after the value.
Sends a macro called \"%1$s\". Add yours above to test that one.
